'''Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Jade)''' is a [[Enchant Crossbow Bolt|bolt enchantment spell]] that requires a [[Magic]] level of 14 to cast. It imbues 10 [[jade bolts]] into 10 [[jade bolts (e)]]  or 10 [[jade dragon bolts]] into 10 [[jade dragon bolts (e)]]. The enchantment gives the ''Earth's Fury'' effect - a chance of rooting your target to the ground for approximately six seconds. The effect has a chance of missing based on the [[Agility]] level of the opponent.
